text: こんど　おとうとも　つれてきて　やろーっと！

structure.jp: つれてきて　やろーっと！
structure.en: I think I'll bring him along!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb followed by くる says the action ends up here, where the speaker is. つれてきて = 'bring (someone) along here'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: つれてきて　やろー
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb says you do the thing for someone, said in a rough, casual way. つれてきて　やろー = 'I'll bring him along (for him)'.

patterns.name: 〜ようっと
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus っと is what you say to yourself when you have just made up your mind. やろー is a drawn-out やろう. やろーっと = 'I think I'll do that'.
